science: Read actual public apparatus, starter, oracle, radial BVP reference, validator, tests, AUTHOR and validation reports. Joint first-moment concentrations obey coupled radial diffusion under one common gate. Analytic decaying mode and Robin signs give capture -4*pi*a*D*A; reference solves the full concentration/flux BVP and independently reads surface reaction. Starter is a coherent stationary-mean reactivity approximation, missing correlations between gate and near-surface concentration.
public_input_review: One common whole-surface independent Markov gate, finite instantaneous local reaction rule, reflected survivors, no surface storage or saturation, maintained infinite reservoir and full joint stationary preparation define the physics. Public text does not prescribe joint equations or a correction. Neutral full-replacement instruction; None parameter; Docker copies only README/model/public test/data; no model inspection in grading.
calibration_review: 288 records at 18 equal-reactivity controls. Exact common calibration law for both models has strictly positive diffusivity derivative throughout the parameter range. Fixed sigma .01 is independent of the signal and unknown diffusivity.
grading_review: All256 noisy fits and oracle predictions pass; maximum oracle hidden error .0002094 and minimum shortcut diagnostic error .43222 at .04 threshold.144 domain corner checks,31 full-range parameter recoveries, outer-radius convergence, conservation, density positivity, relabeling and fast/slow limits reviewed. Local oracle7/7; shortcut4pass+3intended physics failures.
classification_caveat: Keeping stationary-average reactivity without gate-conditioned depletion is physical failure. Recognizing the coupled model but making algebraic, numerical or implementation errors must be recorded separately.
